playable_gate_expression.meaning: ALL 7 boolean flags must be non-zero

flag_dependencies.bWebServerLive[99]: TCP pong received - requires active TCP connection to matching server
flag_dependencies.bNesysServerLive[100]: NESYS certificate authenticated - NESYS state byte 1600 == 1 AND not in maintenance
flag_dependencies.bNesicaReception[101]: NESiCA reception active - set by game live state
flag_dependencies.bLiveFromTestmode[102]: Test mode live - set by test mode state
flag_dependencies.bLiveFromGame[103]: Game live - set by game live state
flag_dependencies.bGameConnect[104]: Game connected - TCP connection to matching server established
flag_dependencies.bHttpSuccess[105]: HTTP success - HTTP request completed successfully

bNesysServerLive[100].certificate_detail: NESYS state byte at offset 1600 must equal 1. This is set by the NESYS control system after certificate authentication succeeds.
bNesysServerLive[100].pipe_detail: No dependency on named pipe. The NESYS state is set via HTTP certificate validation, not pipe communication.
bNesysServerLive[100].bypass_risk: Certificate authentication is required for NESYS state to be valid

bGameConnect[104].meaning: TCP connection to matching server is active
bGameConnect[104].bypass_risk: TCP connection is required for online play

bWebServerLive[99].meaning: Web server (matching server) responded to pong

bHttpSuccess[105].bypass_risk: HTTP request is required for online state

ini_matching_path.detail: INI config provides matching server address, but does NOT bypass bNesysServerLive gate. The game still requires all 7 flags to be true.
ini_matching_path.evidence: sub_142C71510 is called regardless of matching server source

card_profile_system.detail: Card profile can be stored locally and loaded on card tap. This does not affect bNesysServerLive or any online gate.
card_profile_system.implementation: Store card data in local JSON file, load on card tap event

tutorial_bypass.detail: Tutorial requires online gate to be passed. Cannot bypass without setting bNesysServerLive.
tutorial_bypass.reason: sub_142C71510 checks all 7 flags including bNesysServerLive

local_battle.detail: Local battle requires online gate to be passed.
